description: Machine-readable deployment-coverage declaration for every file the Hermes Mini runtime executes from ~/.hermes/scripts and ~/Library/LaunchAgents. Every live file must be (a) governed by one of the listed bundle manifests, (b) a declared direct-deploy file that must byte-match its release mirror (machine-setup/mini-scripts under runtime-current), or (c) an explicitly declared mini-local file with a reason. The fleet-outcome probe's deployment_coverage operational check enforces this; an undeclared live file is an alarm, ending the class where 'intentionally local' and 'forgotten' were indistinguishable. Pinned exceptions accept a known-drifted live sha until their reconcile task lands; a pinned file may also match its governed source (the pin is then stale and reported as evidence only).
